about: 3MF conformance corpus (M00-T10, TESTING.md 6). One row per file; copies sit beside this file with their sha256. run.py runs every row through tools/py/validate_3mf.py and the TypeScript mirror. A changed expectation carries a reason.

cotter-bin.note: the save holds the bin parts under the shelf file name with a fourth ABS slot the owner added; type and ids compare on the three generator slots

sash.note: sash (4) drops the unused fourth slot; type and ids compare on the three slots both files hold

baffle-pre-r2.note: generator baffle.3mf (Sep 8) is not in the evidence copies; the save is checked alone

knurl.note: the app export has no project_settings, so type and ids are not compared; the owner moved the accent parts from slot 4 to slot 2 and saved with 2 filaments, so the part map differs

rows.edit: every component p:path in 3D/3dmodel.model set to /3D/Objects/missing.model
the first triangle of 3D/Objects/hackbuild-coin-nfc_2.model removed, so the part is open
the build item of object 4 copied with the same transform, so two coins stack

rows.reason: the named failure is CHK-ART-01 (export completeness); the TENON writer predates the 127-key template, so under --export it also fails CHK-3MF-02 on 37 absent template keys, CHK-3MF-03 on the 7 seed-only vectors outside the template and CHK-3MF-07 on the three kept keys it never wrote (M00-T09 step 1)

M00-T10 step 2 expects pass; measured 2026-10-05: part pick_white (3D/Objects/object_3.model object 1) holds 3106 vertices at 2732 distinct positions, and after the coincident vertices merge 475 edges are shared by 4 faces, so CHK-PRT-01 topology fails (not watertight after vertex merge). CHK-3MF-06 passes. The plate is recorded as found, never fixed in place; the SPRUE writer fix belongs to M00-T12

the KNURL app export carries no Metadata/project_settings.config (CHK-3MF-06 package rule) and four meshes that are open after vertex merge (tray, lid, wheel and star bodies, CHK-PRT-01); recorded, never fixed in place
